sequence.rule: All independently authorized caller/source/channel/ownership/budget prerequisites already exist; probe cannot collect them using its own input.
Validate already-held independent bindings and current ownership before any content read; missing/wrong binding denies all reads.
Bind exactly one routine invocation in the same live owner context, without a file ledger. Unknown consumption denies retry; new wrappers create no allowance.
Only the existing dedicated handle from offset zero, exact registered original length, finite subdivisions in one bounded operation; no extra EOF read or alternative path.
Compare raw length/hash to preexisting original; no JSON instructions, reference traversal, authority reconstruction or execution.
Caller closes independently established dedicated own handle once, including on read/compare failure. Never adopt/close an unknown foreign handle; known prior ownership survives a payload mismatch.
Only a bounded in-memory outcome after cleanup attempt, preserving original errors and missing evidence. No self-future-exit claim or durable publication.

startup_cleanup_evidence.contract_vs_fact: Sequence is mandatory future behavior, not actual compliance evidence.
startup_cleanup_evidence.originality: Each authorized acquisition/identity/read/close operation binds exact source, phase, process, owner, resource identity and handle generation with original result/error.
startup_cleanup_evidence.failure_preservation: Primary and cleanup errors both retained; no retry, fabricated success or closed-handle reconstruction.
startup_cleanup_evidence.unknowns: Unknown source/identity blocks before read; missing required close proof prevents confirmed completion.
startup_cleanup_evidence.form_policy: No new evidence carrier implementation or implicit extension of FG/FI/FK V1 forms.
startup_cleanup_evidence.completion_limit: Routine/handle completion only. Existing caller remains running; its future terminal exit is not claimed.

forbidden: Any read without all prior independent pre-read requirements.
File creation, write, flush, rename, reservation, publication or ledger generation.
Read-driven discovery of paths, source authority, identity or permissions.
Process creation or termination by the probe.
Recorder, platform test, matrix, field/API/snapshot or memory operation.
Rights elevation or retry after failed/ambiguous consumption.
Reuse of reserve_dispatch, start_once, observe_once, ChildOwner or RecorderSupervisor as probe wrappers.
Assuming SourceLease is the admitted single-held-handle implementation.
Output through stdout, logging, pipe or file by the probe.
Unapproved metadata collection or handle acquisition disguised as preparation.
